tagline: Leo performs for an audience of one, checks whether it landed, and never quite believes the review even when it is glowing.
overview: The Lion is not proud because it thinks it is better than you. It is proud because it is on fire, the fire is visible from far off, and a fire nobody notices may as well be unlit. Leo is a fire sign, so it moves on enthusiasm, not deliberation, and a fixed sign, so that enthusiasm arrives once and stays. The Sun rules it, which is unusual: a sign under the Sun never quite stops checking its own effect on a room.

Now the difficulty. A fixed fire sign is a spotlight with a lightbulb that cannot be dimmed, which means Leo lives under a permanent condition of visibility, and permanent visibility is exhausting to someone who wants to be chosen rather than observed. Recognition is not vanity; it is evidence. Without a signal that the room registered them, Leo is not sad exactly — it is unmoored, and the hunt for that signal is where the sign spends an unreasonable number of hours.

What Leo wants is not applause. It is specificity: that particular person understood that particular thing and did not need it explained. That is a far higher bar, and it is why the sign can be undone by a lukewarm reaction at a dinner table for a week. The Lion's real skill is generosity with an audience — teaching, encouraging, keeping the temperature of a group up after everyone else has quietly lost interest. The Peridot is the traditional birthstone: a green that stays cool under heat.
callout_text: Leo gives generously in order to be recognized, and would rather be genuinely seen by one person than broadly applauded by forty.
traits_lede: Every strength and weakness here is the same organ seen from two directions. The drive to be seen is precisely what makes Leo warm, generous and worth following, and precisely what makes the sign vulnerable to the day nobody claps.
strengths: Warmth — You make people feel like the reason the room got brighter.
Guts — You will take the stage, the bet, the job, before you feel ready.
Generosity — Credit, money, time; the sign gives it and then forgets it gave it.
Loyalty — A Leo defends its people in public, at volume, without checking the facts.
Leadership — You raise the temperature and expect everyone to keep up.
weaknesses: Ego in the draft — Editing a Leo's work is harder than writing it.
Performing — The version of you in public is edited, and the editing is exhausting.
Stubbornness — Fixed fire does not relight. Once the position is set, it stays set.
Appetite for applause — A quiet week gets read as disapproval, and it is usually right.
Dramatising — The story grows each retelling until the facts sit somewhere in the middle.
love_lede: Leo falls hard and does not do it quietly. The sign wants to be adored by someone specific, and it will do the courting, the planning and the showing up, provided the other person is willing to look.
love: Leo courts the way other signs receive: loudly, and with a clear sense of occasion. There will be a gesture — a trip arranged, a public declaration, a project started partly because it creates a story with someone in it. Inside a relationship the sign is loyal almost absurdly and attentive to a degree that can feel like surveillance until you understand where it comes from. Leo remembers what you did on the bad Tuesday because Leo needed the room to be warm for them.

The failure mode is not infidelity so much as miscalibration. Leo gives at full volume and then reads the room; if the return signal is warm, it accelerates. If it is flat, the sign does not ask what is wrong. It tries harder, harder still, and eventually concludes it is being ignored rather than that it misread the situation. Aquarius, the opposite sign, is the interesting case precisely because it admires the show and declines to join it.
friends: Leo is a superb friend and a slightly demanding one. It shows up for the big nights, organizes them, and notices out loud that you look tired and will not let it go. Loyalty runs loud as well: a Leo will defend you in front of people you would have preferred to keep out of it. The upside is that you never have to wonder where you stand. The downside is never being left alone with a decision.

Friendship is also where the sign is most often disappointed. Leo tends to attach quickly, invest heavily, and then feel faintly cheated when the other friendship settles into a comfortable, equal, unremarkable tempo. Nothing was actually wrong; the temperature simply stopped being extraordinary. The reliable fix is to ask for something specific rather than asking to be noticed, which is the one request Leo finds nearly impossible to make and nearly always the right one.
career: Leo wants its name on the door, which is a working style rather than a vanity. The sign needs ownership of the outcome in order to stay motivated, and it is genuinely worse at work that is shared anonymously than the mythology suggests; a Leo in a corner office with no public-facing role is a slow emergency. Where the sign thrives is anywhere with a name attached — teaching, performing, selling, founding, any job where the win can be pointed at.

The management problem is delegation. Leo finds it genuinely difficult to hand a task to someone less glittering, and ends up doing the important work twice: once properly, and once again because the second person needed rescuing. Aquarius, the opposite sign, is the useful corrective, because it structures rather than performs and will happily supply the boring scaffolding that lets a bright person look good in public without privately falling apart. Ask a Leo for a timeline, not for reassurance, and the work improves.
man: The Leo man is more direct than his reputation. He will tell you he likes you within weeks, he means it, and he does not enjoy being asked to prove it. Chasing is not his style; deciding is. He is drawn to women who have a thing of their own — a practice, a project, an opinion he has not heard him state — because a partner with no center of gravity bores him by autumn.

His difficulty is the audience. A Leo man will make a decision privately, then perform it, then be faintly confused when the performance is treated as the whole of the information. He also has a hard time receiving help: the offer registers as an assessment. The most effective way to be with him is to be direct about the small thing and let him have the ceremony around the big one.
woman: The Leo woman does not play hard to get and finds the suggestion faintly insulting. She knows what she wants, she says so early, and she is more comfortable with a clear no than with a hopeful maybe. What she does need is to be chosen out loud. A woman who is quietly excellent at her job but never mentions it is, in a Leo's eyes, presenting no information at all.

In practice she manages other people's egos fluently, which reads as a soft manner. It is a woman who has worked out exactly how much room a man needs, and gives him it, and expects the same courtesy back. The risk is that she overextends in private to keep the peace in public, then is genuinely astonished to be tired. Ask her directly about her own day. She will answer the question about your day first, then her own.

faq.a: The Sun does not arrive in Leo at midnight on July 23. It arrives at an exact moment in Earth's orbit, and that moment lands on either side of the calendar date depending on the year. Since the Sun's path shifts slightly with each orbit, the boundary also moves by roughly 18 hours year to year. Check the recorded birth time, not just the date.

faq.q: What is Leo's element and modality?
faq.a: Leo is a fire sign with a fixed modality, ruled by the Sun. Fire means the sign is driven by enthusiasm, instinct and appetite rather than by argument or analysis: it acts first and reasons afterwards. Fixed means the decision, once made, stays made. A Leo does not revisit a position out of fashion and does not enjoy watching other people do so. The Sun as ruler also makes Leo unusually attached to being the center of its own story.

faq.q: Who is Leo most compatible with?
faq.a: Leo usually gets along best with Gemini, Libra and Sagittarius. Gemini matches the speed and enjoys the banter; Libra flatters without competing and negotiates well; Sagittarius shares the fire and never mistakes intensity for a problem. Aquarius, the opposite sign, is the harder pairing and often the more instructive one: it admires the same freedom Leo does and refuses the same audience, which forces both to find out what they actually want.

faq.q: How do I know if I'm really a Leo?
faq.a: Check your reaction to being ignored. If a room going quiet registers as a problem to be solved, if you rehearse the sentence you will say later, if praise lands and disapproval genuinely hurts rather than being filed away, and if you keep things you made simply because someone admired them, that is Leo. Also look at how you give. A Leo is generous to the point of interference and finds the interference hard to apologise for.

faq.q: Why do Leos need so much praise?
faq.a: Because a fixed fire sign has no other way to check whether something landed. Water signs read a room by temperature, air signs by argument; Leo reads it by reaction. Praise is not vanity talking — it is data. Without it the sign has to guess, and Leo's guess about itself is worse than anyone else's. Practically: tell someone you love that the thing they made worked. Four seconds of that is worth a week of good intentions.

Constantly, and the confidence is the point. Leo is not confident the way a person is when they do not doubt themselves; it is confident the way a person performs confidence, because the alternative is being known without it. That is why criticism lands hard on a sign that looks like it could absorb anything, and why the flattery Leo cannot resist is usually the kind that arrives with an audience.
